title: Choose the visual world for Idea Bank
question: The roll assigned Market Price Card. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Market Price Card
options.lineage: Thai market and shop price cards: fluorescent card stock, marker numerals
options.thesis: Every idea wears its score like a price card at a ตลาดนัด stall: the number you read from across the aisle.
options.viewport: Clean list shell (filters left, ideas right); each row ends in a fluorescent score card, card colour = track, marker-style /20 numeral.
options.risk: Turns into a costume if marker type leaks beyond the score numerals and track cards.

raised.raise: Compare view uses a strict hairline module grid so four ideas line up row by row.
Score map encodes total score as dot diameter on a fixed ramp.
Columns never move in compare and shortlist; only values change.
Flat unmodulated colour only: no gradients, glass or grain.

options.label: TCAS Choice Slip
options.lineage: Thai university admission choice slips, ranked อันดับ 1–4
options.thesis: Choosing a hackathon idea is ranking your อันดับ 1–4, the ritual every Thai student has done.
options.viewport: List shell plus a persistent four-slot ranking tray; the shortlist is literally อันดับ 1–4.
options.risk: Familiar official-form look; can read bureaucratic and close to the category standard.

options.label: Dense Module Mosaic
options.thesis: Pack every idea into ruled modules with small red tabs.
options.viewport: A mosaic of 145 boxed idea modules.
options.case: Loses on audience: the team asked for nothing too dense.
options.kept: Strict hairline module grid in the compare view.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Ideas as stars, score as magnitude.
options.case: Strong for the score map only; the team does not identify with star charts.
options.kept: Dot diameter as score in the score map.
options.risk: Dark night chart hurts long Thai reading.

options.label: Split-Flap Board
options.case: Rows fit ranking but the world is foreign to the team and dark.
options.risk: Costume of an instrument on a working screen.

options.label: Garden Guide Map
options.thesis: Tracks as coloured lobes of land.
options.case: Playful but obscures comparison; loses both axes.
options.risk: Decorative, which the team asked to avoid.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean product dashboard: sidebar filters, card grid, side panel.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, search bar, card grid, slide-over detail.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every SaaS template, which the team asked to avoid.
